nodes.text: The performance hall is packed. Rows of folding chairs, standing room in the back, faces you recognize and dozens you don't.
Stage lights cut through the dimness, casting long shadows behind the equipment. The microphone stand gleams under the spotlight.
Your heart is hammering. This is it.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: This is it. Everything we've worked for.

nodes.speaker: Laura
nodes.text: There are so many people...

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: Good. More people to impress.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: Let's give them something beautiful.
The countdown. Three... two... one.
The final chord rings out and hangs in the air. For one perfect, suspended moment -- silence.
Then the applause hits like a wave. Cheering. Whistling. Someone in the back row is on their feet.

nodes.speaker: Laura
nodes.text: We did it! Oh my god, we actually did it!

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: Not bad. Not bad at all.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: That was perfect. You were all perfect.
Tiffany is beaming, genuinely beaming, and for a moment the weight she's been carrying seems to lift.
But then you see it. Hanami, just offstage, swaying on her feet. Her hand shoots out to grip the edge of a desk.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: I'm... I just need a second...

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: Hanami--
Cassian moves fast. His arm catches her just as her knees buckle. The audience can't see -- they're still clapping, still cheering.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: Keep smiling. Everyone keep smiling.
Tiffany's voice is steady but her eyes are wide. She steps forward, drawing the audience's attention with a wave and a bow.

nodes.speaker: Laura
nodes.text: Thank you all so much! We're the music club, and we hope you enjoyed our performance!
Laura's voice barely shakes. She holds the crowd's gaze while behind her, Cassian helps Hanami to a chair backstage.
The applause fades. The lights come up. To everyone out there, it was a triumph.
But backstage, something has broken.
